_doc: 2026-11-25 사용자 제안 스타일(굵은 외곽선 + 원색 평면 + 무표정 단순 캐릭터 + 촘촘한 배경) 시험 3장. 참고 그림의 캐릭터(곰·고양이)는 따라 그리지 않고 그림 문법만 가져온다.

jobs.prompt: Draw OUR character from the second reference image (a small chubby chipmunk: orange-tan fur, dark brown back and head stripes, cream belly and muzzle, small round ears, short bushy tail, a small red neck ribbon) in the ART STYLE of the first reference image: clean bold black ink outlines of even weight, flat vivid colour fills with no gradients, simple flat cel shadow blocks, very simple deadpan cute face with tiny black dot eyes, a small black nose and a tiny mouth line, no blush, no sparkle eyes. Do NOT draw the bear or the cat from the first image; only borrow its line and colour style. Full body, standing upright on two legs, front three-quarter view, calm deadpan expression, holding one acorn with both paws. Centered, plenty of margin. No text. Background: one perfectly flat uniform pure magenta (#FF00FF), no shadow on the background. Do not use magenta or pink on the character.

A single isolated building asset for a mobile game village map, in the ART STYLE of the reference image: clean bold black ink outlines, flat vivid colour fills (fresh yellow-green, lime, warm orange accents, sky blue), simple flat cel shadow blocks, lots of small hand-drawn detail lines like the reference but a clear bold silhouette. Subject: the poorest home in a cozy forest village of animals: a small patched canvas tent pitched under a leafy tree, a tiny campfire pot, a wooden crate as a table, a blank wooden mailbox, a few ferns and rocks. Clean bright colours, poverty shown only by smallness and patches. Three-quarter front view from slightly above, standing on a round grassy dirt ground patch spanning about 84% of the image width, nothing cropped. No characters, no animals, no text, no letters, no numbers. Background: one perfectly flat uniform pure magenta (#FF00FF), no shadow on the background. Do not use magenta or pink on the subject.

Mobile game background, portrait 9:16, in the ART STYLE of the first reference image: clean bold black ink outlines, flat vivid colours (yellow-green, lime, warm orange accents, bright sky blue), simple flat shadow blocks, hand-drawn detail lines. Use the LAYOUT of the second reference image exactly: sky at the top, a band of distant forest trees, a meadow with nine EMPTY flat oval grassy clearings in three rows (left, centre, right) joined by one winding light dirt path, and an open dirt clearing across the bottom 18% where a character will stand. Keep the clearings and the bottom clearing EMPTY and calm with low detail so buildings and UI can sit on top; put the dense detailed foliage (big leaves, ferns, palms, rocks) only around the edges. No buildings, no characters, no animals, no vehicles, no text, no frame.
